name: Resource sentinel
description: Samples host disk, memory and CPU on a schedule and alerts you ONLY when one crosses its warning threshold — quiet when everything is healthy. Uses only built-in system stats (no extra software to install) and works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Memory uses true available memory on Linux and Windows; macOS doesn't expose that to a pure check, so memory is shown there but not alerted on. It reads the HOST machine, so in a Hub (many instances on one machine) enabling it on a single instance covers them all. Read-only: it checks the machine, it never places or changes a trade.
author: core
